proposal: Single-storey side extension beside a protected lime

pages.text:
Site: 22 Linnet Row, Eastmere
Dwelling: end-terrace, 2 bedrooms
Proposal: single-storey side extension
Parking: on-street

The side extension is 2.8 m wide and 6.0 m deep.
The lime tree in the front garden is 4 m from the new wall.
